description: Burritos in four rooms wired together. Standing on the pressure plate in one half opens the door in the other: the top chef's plate lets the bottom chef reach the meat, the bottom chef's plate lets the top chef reach the boards. Plates come back clean.
strategy: Take turns on the plates. The top chef stands while the bottom chef fetches beef, chicken and tortillas; then the bottom chef stands while the top chef crosses to chop. Cook together, then let the top chef assemble and serve.
